description: Header file defining the interface for gnutls OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) handling within the lighttpd server. It declares structures, functions for creating, freeing, and managing OCSP responses, including loading and searching in PEM and DER formats.

classes.name: liGnuTLSOCSP
classes.description: A structure representing OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) context or data within the lighttpd gnutls module.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of liGnuTLSOCSP.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_free
methods.description: Frees the memory and resources associated with an liGnuTLSOCSP instance.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_use
methods.description: Associates an liGnuTLSOCSP instance with gnutls credentials.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_add
methods.description: Loads an OCSP response from a file (DER or PEM encoded) into the OCSP context.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_search
methods.description: Searches in a PEM file for an OCSP response block and adds it if found.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_search_datum
methods.description: Searches within a gnutls_datum_t in memory for an OCSP response block and adds it.
